findings.source_quote: "And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps" (Revelation 14:2) According to the book of Revelation, God's throne is surrounded by sound: thundering and lightning; praises flowing from the angels, the four beasts and twenty elders, and the great multitude which no man can number; and the new song by the one hundred and forty four thousand.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original wording/numbering exactly as in the authoritative English source. In the translated paragraph, change the phrase "четырех животных и двадцати четырех старейшин" to match the source's phrasing "the four beasts and twenty elders", rendered in Russian as "четырех животных и двадцати старейшин" (keep the same numeric/wording as the English source). Preserve all surrounding HTML and punctuation.
